chapter.heading: To Your Name Be the Glory(Psalms 135:1–21)
chapter.v:
Not to
us, O LORD, not to us,but to Your name be the glory,because of Your loving devotion,because of Your faithfulness.

Why should
the nations say,“Where is their God?”

Our God
is in heaven; He does as He pleases.

Their idols
are silver and gold,made by the hands of men.

They have
mouths, but cannot speak;they have eyes, but cannot see;

they have
ears, but cannot hear;they have noses, but cannot smell;

they have
hands, but cannot feel;they have feet, but cannot walk;they cannot even clear their throats.

Those who
make them become like them,as do all who trust in them.

O Israel,
trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

O house
of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

You who
fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

The LORD
is mindful of us; He will bless us.He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;

He will
bless those who fear the LORD—small and great alike.

May the
LORD give you increase,both you and your children.

May you
be blessed by the LORD,the Maker of heaven and earth.

The highest
heavens belong to the LORD,but the earth He has given to mankind.

It is
not the dead who praise the LORD,nor any who descend into silence.

But it
is we who will bless the LORD,both now and forevermore.Hallelujah!
